directions: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent game sprite atlas. Design an ORIGINAL friendly green superhero named Verdant for a portfolio, unrelated to any existing superhero. Mint-green face, teal leaf-shaped swept hair crest, small rounded amber goggles above eyebrows, emerald fitted high-collar suit with a gold diamond seed emblem, short orange scarf neatly inside shoulders. Cute big-head chibi comic sticker art, clean dark teal outlines, rich cel shading, warm friendly eyes. Head and shoulders only. Exactly square 3x3 grid, nine evenly spaced equal cells. Each drawing same scale centered within its cell occupying 72% height, transparent empty margins. Torso/neck/shoulders face forward and remain IDENTICAL across all nine. Only head angle changes, calm friendly expression constant. Row 1: head looks viewer upper-left, up, upper-right. Row 2: viewer left, straight forward, viewer right. Row 3: viewer lower-left, down, lower-right. Turn nose and head, not just eyes. All silhouettes wholly within cells, no cropping. No text, grid lines, symbols, props, backgrounds, shadows or checkerboard. Real transparent alpha. This is the directions atlas; a matching expressions atlas will follow.
